description: This file defines an internal struct 'ValueStopwatch' used for high-performance, non-allocating timing of durations within the Orleans runtime. It provides methods to start, stop, reset, and measure elapsed time, utilizing system diagnostics and stopwatch features.

classes.name: ValueStopwatch
classes.description: A non-allocating, high-performance stopwatch struct for measuring durations with minimal overhead.

methods.name: StartNew
methods.description: Creates and starts a new stopwatch instance, optionally with an initial elapsed duration.

methods.name: FromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a stopped stopwatch from start and end timestamps.

methods.name: GetTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current timestamp from the system stopwatch.

methods.name: GetRawTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the raw internal timestamp value.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stopwatch to a stopped state with zero elapsed time.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the stopwatch and records the elapsed time.
